inputs.text: The apology is just cover: make parents feel guilty while the people directing things stay hidden. More than 70 school positions are on the chopping block, and they’re calling another shortfall unavoidable—as if these repeated crises have no cause. This looks like a managed pressure campaign to get the public to accept cuts without questioning who set these priorities or who benefits from keeping schools under strain.

output.main_topic: Alleged pressure campaign to secure acceptance of school cuts amid a shortfall
subtopics: More than 70 school positions are threatened
The shortfall is described as unavoidable
Responsibility for school priorities is portrayed as concealed

opinions: The repeated crises are treated as though they have no cause.
